useWhen: Determining which privacy regulations apply to your product
Creating a privacy policy for your product
Mapping data processing activities for compliance

workflow.description: Determine target market, user locations, data types, customer segments, industry vertical
Apply geography-based, data-type-based, industry-based triage to identify applicable regulations
Assess compliance gaps for each applicable regulation
Document processing activities, legal basis, data subjects, retention
Evaluate penalties, enforcement likelihood, breach notification requirements
Prioritize remediation by risk and effort
Create tailored privacy policy based on actual data practices

examples.input: We have a B2B SaaS product based in the US. We serve US and EU customers, collect email/name from business users, and use Stripe for payments. Do we need GDPR compliance?
examples.context: B2B SaaS, US company with EU users
examples.output:
**REGULATORY CONTEXT**

| Factor | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Company location | US |
| User locations | US, EU |
| Data collected | Email, name, company (B2B) |
| Industry | SaaS |
| Customer type | Businesses (not consumers) |

**REGULATION TRIAGE**

| Regulation | Applies | Rationale |
|------------|---------|-----------|
| GDPR | YES | EU users present - Article 3 applies |
| CCPA | NO | B2B data, not consumer |
| HIPAA | NO | No health data |
| PCI-DSS | PARTIAL | Stripe handles cards, need compliance |

**GDPR ASSESSMENT**

| Requirement | Status | Gap |
|-------------|--------|-----|
| Lawful basis | Legitimate interest | Document basis |
| Privacy policy | Missing | Create policy |
| Data subject rights | Partial | Need export/deletion |
| DPO | Required | Appoint DPO |
| Data processing agreement | Missing | Create DPA |

**DATA PROCESSING**

| Activity | Data | Legal Basis | Retention |
|----------|------|-------------|----------|
| Account creation | Email, name | Contract | Account lifetime |
| Payment processing | Payment data | Legal obligation | Financial records |
| Analytics | Usage data | Legitimate interest | 2 years |

**RISK ASSESSMENT**

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|--------|------------|
| GDPR fine | Medium | High | Implement compliance |
| User complaint | Medium | Medium | Build rights fulfillment |

**REMEDIATION ROADMAP**

| Priority | Action | Effort | Timeline |
|----------|--------|--------|----------|
| 1 | Publish privacy policy | Low | 1 week |
| 2 | Implement data export | Medium | 2 weeks |
| 3 | Implement deletion | Medium | 2 weeks |
| 4 | Sign DPA with vendors | Low | 1 week |
| 5 | Document lawful basis | Low | 1 week |

examples.input: We have a consumer mobile app based in California with 100K users. We collect personal data including location, device info, and behavioral data for advertising.
examples.output:
**REGULATORY CONTEXT**

| Factor | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Company location | California, US |
| User locations | US primarily |
| Data collected | Location, device, behavioral, advertising IDs |
| Industry | Consumer mobile |
| Customer type | Consumers |

**REGULATION TRIAGE**

| Regulation | Applies | Rationale |
|------------|---------|-----------|
| CCPA/CPRA | YES | California company, consumer data |
| GDPR | NO | No EU users |
| COPPA | POSSIBLE | Check if under 13 users |

**CCPA ASSESSMENT**

| Requirement | Status | Gap |
|-------------|--------|-----|
| Privacy policy | Outdated | Update for CPRA |
| Right to delete | Partial | Need full pipeline |
| Right to opt-out | Missing | Need opt-out mechanism |
|

| Missing | Implement signal |
| Sensitive data | Partial | Limit collection |

**RISK ASSESSMENT**

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact |
|------|-----------|--------|
| CCPA fine | High | $7,500/intentional |
| Private lawsuit | Medium | Statutory damages |

**REMEDIATION ROADMAP**

| Priority | Action | Effort | Timeline |
|----------|--------|--------|----------|
| 1 | Add opt-out button | Low | 1 week |
| 2 | Update privacy policy | Low | 1 week |
| 3 | Build deletion pipeline | Medium | 2 weeks |
| 4 | Implement GPC (global privacy control) | Medium | 2 weeks |
| 5 | Audit data collection | Medium | 2 weeks |

**PRIVACY POLICY DRAFT**

*Sections needed:*
- Categories of data collected
- Sources of data
- Purposes for processing
- Categories of third parties
- Rights under CCPA
- How to exercise rights
